environment: Disposable isolated PostgreSQL; fictional single-person and four-person fixtures; no hosted mutations or provider calls

checks.name: Original agreed plan, four private responses and immutable history survive v2 migration
Only three reviewed legacy function bodies change; every existing function permission remains
Only newly created trips use the new planning workflow
Signed-out users cannot access the new endpoint
Unverified users are denied
Cross-trip data reads and writes are denied
Original trips cannot be silently converted to v2
Legacy private-input endpoint cannot bypass v2
Legacy plan endpoint cannot bypass v2 gates
Generation waits for every included traveller
Summary must be explicitly acknowledged
Availability outside the tentative interval is rejected
Forged actor fields are rejected
Only the author receives their private city, budget and requirement text
Personal intervals differ; generation uses their shared overlap and only shareable choices
Outbound and return travel buffers are excluded from the shared destination itinerary
Every included person must consent to Free Tier generation
Only the organiser can generate or lock
Duplicate generation ticket cannot trigger another provider call
Malformed or invented AI references are rejected
Server builds a complete gap-free shared timeline with meals, stays and all-in estimate
Generation finish is idempotent without a second version
Idempotency receipts cannot be reused with changed data
Open step decisions block personal review and lock
Private ballots stay hidden until closure; plurality resolves compatible step alternatives
Organiser cannot lock while a member has not reviewed this version
A 2–2 concern vote keeps the step; an author’s must-have concern remains blocking
Another person cannot resolve the author’s private requirement
Only the affected author can explicitly resolve their must-have concern
A strict majority applies a step change and requires fresh personal review
Organiser locks only the resolved exact version reviewed by every included traveller
A locked itinerary cannot be edited through a step concern
A locked itinerary cannot be silently regenerated
Historical versions retain their original shareable reference labels and lock record
Reopened personal input blocks old agreement and generation
Reopening input invalidates the current view without deleting locked history
Plan snapshots are immutable at database level
All v2 operations leave the pre-existing agreed trip unchanged
A complete but over-budget itinerary cannot receive personal approval
Another confirmed member never receives the first author’s distinct private requirement
Changed input during generation rejects the in-flight AI result
Deadline extension requires explicit acknowledgement
Non-overlapping availability cannot be voted or generated away
Tied alternatives remain unresolved and block review
Oversubscribed shareable wishes become an explicit vote; rejected options are recorded rather than silently dropped
Client/server schedules agree across midnight, clipped activity blocks and year boundaries
Archived private summaries are read-only
Archive preserves the new private summaries and shared version history
Forward requirement migration leaves every prior itinerary document and version unchanged
Every existing function permission is preserved by the forward correction
New confirmation requires an owner-reviewed shared request list
A one-person trip includes surfing, scuba, sailing and meal requests when time and budget fit without any group vote
Server prioritises hard activities even if Gemini returns flexible activities first
Shared context contains no private prose, private ceiling or computed minimum budget
Budget-infeasible must-haves are explicitly excluded without exceeding the private ceiling
A traveller cannot approve exclusions without explicit acknowledgement
A one-person itinerary with disclosed exclusions locks only after the affected owner explicitly accepts them
Insufficient common activity slots produce a visible timing exclusion for hard requests
An unverified travel condition is never falsely reported as satisfied
Corrected requirement outcomes remain inaccessible to outsiders
History retains approved requests and outcomes without the owner-private answer mapping
After joining, a second traveller sees only their own requirement outcomes and private answers
The organiser cannot lock a corrected plan until every included traveller reviews
A majority step change records the displaced request as excluded and clears current reviews
Every new private helper is denied to public, anonymous and authenticated direct callers
Meal requests cannot be forged as replacement activities
A rejected invalid replacement leaves the plan and existing votes unchanged
